content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Aiken

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's education and experience thresholds—typically a bachelor's degree plus three years of project experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Gather your project documentation now to support your application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Our classes meet the PMI requirement for formal instruction and are designed for working professionals in Aiken's dynamic industries—from nuclear and advanced manufacturing to healthcare and government. Study at your own pace within our cohort schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay the associated PMI exam fee when you submit. Granite PM Academy staff can answer questions about the process, but your application goes directly to PMI for review and approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner once your application is approved. Our instructors remain available to clarify challenging concepts as you finalize your readiness.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After you pass, your PMP credential is valid for three years. During this renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or professional activities. Renew before expiration by reporting your PDUs and paying PMI's renewal fee to keep your credential active.

fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
